breakdown.description: The prompt treats the internal torque as uniform over the whole shaft, even though applied torques at intermediate locations make the internal torque piecewise constant.
breakdown.reason: The generated specification correctly treats the internal torque as piecewise constant rather than uniform over the whole shaft. It explicitly defines T_int = +200000 N·mm for the segment 400 mm < x ≤ 1200 mm and T_int = 0 N·mm for the segment 0 ≤ x ≤ 400 mm, matching the equilibrium-based approach required by the ground truth. It even explicitly flags the conflicting instruction from the incomplete prompt and overrides it with the correct equilibrium-based segment torques.
